notes: Forget to stop the timer? It now checks in. Fifteen minutes past your target (or every hour if there isn't one), a "Still studying?" prompt appears. Answer yes and it carries on; if nobody answers within ten minutes it pauses itself at the moment it asked, so the time you weren't there is never logged. This covers the task timer and Study Session, pomodoro included.
A timer left running when you closed the app is now found paused at its check-in with your real minutes kept, instead of being thrown away the next morning.
Study Session now logs only the time actually counted. Pauses and pomodoro breaks used to be logged as study.

In the Scheduler you can place part of a task. Drop it on a day and you're asked how long; put two hours of a six-hour task on Monday and it stays in the Unscheduled list with four hours to go. Auto-Schedule keeps the blocks you placed and plans only the rest.
In full-screen timer, Cancel works again (its confirmation was opening hidden behind the timer), and Pause no longer makes the screen flash.
